purpose: pretraining-corpus generation via multi-teacher distillation (NOT instruction tuning). Majority of text is plain natural-language documents.
routing: decided_by_benchmark; see reports/teacher_benchmark.json -> routing_recommendation. Ensembles used for high-value factual/scientific concepts (>=2 independent teachers).
context_length_note: Log-decaying: most compute on short-medium docs; small but meaningful fraction at 8K-32K to induce long-context capability without wasting budget. Long docs are multi-section educational articles / multi-document syntheses, not padded short ones.

synthetic_vs_sourced.note: 100% synthetic is suboptimal (model collapse risk, knowledge loss). Source-grounded seeds (open OER, public references) anchor facts; teachers synthesize/expand, never just paraphrase.

A_100M.note: Chinchilla would suggest >=20B for compute-optimal 1-2B, but Phi-series show curated 100B-level corpora work; 100M is a smoke test only.

B_500M.note: Knowledge-dense 500M can beat multi-B raw web for a 1-2B model (Phi-1.5 evidence).

C_1B.note: Strong quality/quantity balance for 1-2B with curated distillation. Recommended.

D_3B_plus.note: Diminishing returns past ~1-2B curated tokens for 1-2B params; gains marginal unless adding new domains.

reasoning_representation: concise verifiable derivations (proofs, explicit calculations, structured steps with intermediate conclusions). NOT verbose private CoT for every example. Only ~10-15% of corpus is reasoning-traced.

verification.code: execute in sandbox, assert expected output
verification.science: multi-teacher agreement + reject on conflict that cannot be resolved
verification.general: independent verification pass by a different teacher

pilot.purpose: measure quality, redundancy, token distribution, throughput, verification failure rate, cost before scaling
